Appliance Error Code Guide / CE

CESamsung

Samsung dishwasher CE

Context

Communication between the panel and other controls is interrupted.

Checks

  1. Record the complete display, active cycle and model from its label.
  2. Check whether the message coincides with a recent power interruption.

Next action

If it persists, report the code and timing to Samsung official service; do not open the control panel or wiring.

Sources

  • Samsung US — dishwasher error codes ↗

Checked on 2026-10-27

Scope

Samsung US dishwashers with digital code displays covered by this guide; do not translate into blinking-light patterns.
